Laura / team / Joanna — quick runbook items and recommendations: 

1) Service account naming- recommended: acme-redwood-scim@redwood-infra (system account)
2) SCIM provisioning- required attributes: userName, externalId, givenName, familyName, emails[type=work], active, groups- We support SCIM 2.0 push provisioning; Okta scoped provisioning app is fine (no need for full admin interactive user). Please ensure the provisioning app has write and group membership scopes.
3) SAML notes- We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. For a smoother UX we recommend SP-initiated for initial testing; saml-metadata.xml looks good but we'll validate the certificate thumbprint.
4) IP allowlist- The CIDRs listed should work for our control plane APIs; for Dedicated/Private, we'll need their egress ranges for the host environment as well.
5) Org policies- If Acme enforces conditional access (MFA), we'll accept it, but note we need at least one service account or service-to-service credential exempted from interactive MFA (scoped to provisioning).

Attachment: internal-access-runbook.md (internal runbook stub)

I can present the mapping and runbook at the kickoff. If anyone sees gaps, flag them now.

-Rishi
